standard.description: Portable AIOS linked-project quality pipeline. Tier 1 is required for every active project; production-app and domain-specific gates apply only when a project declares the matching applicability tag.

tiers.label: Tier 1 Core
tiers.description: Portable gates required for every linked project.

tiers.label: Production App
tiers.description: Additional release confidence gates for deployed products.

tiers.label: Domain Specific
tiers.description: Only required when the project has the matching product domain.

platform_control_plane.label: Platform/control-plane
platform_control_plane.readiness_note: AIOS itself must prove both platform runtime health and experiment/pre-PR governance health.

production_public_web_app.label: Production/public web app
production_public_web_app.readiness_note: Public apps require release confidence, environment checks, secret/dependency safety, smoke or e2e coverage, and remote CI proof or approved local CI replacement proof.

developer_tool_package.label: Developer tool/package
developer_tool_package.readiness_note: Tools and packages require package/build or consumer smoke evidence in addition to tests and static checks.

python_data_research_course.label: Python/data/research/course
python_data_research_course.readiness_note: Research, course, and data repos use validation gates that fit notebooks, scripts, datasets, or assignment structure instead of fake app builds.

content_vault_container.label: Content/vault/container
content_vault_container.readiness_note: Content and container repos require aggregate or delegated validation; diff-only floor checks are not mature readiness.

non_remote_ci_exception_schema.readiness_rule: A repo without remote CI is not adoption-ready unless this exception is recorded in AIOS truth and the replacement local proof passes.

adoption_readiness_rule.aios_owned_commands: Executable commands live in AIOS-owned config/quality-gates.json and config/quality-pipeline.json.
adoption_readiness_rule.weak_marker_rule: A repo with floor_only or pre_cr_only maturity cannot be marked adoption-ready.
